hook_text: One combine harvester can harvest more maize in a day than a family could in a whole season.
clip_script: Bothaville, in the Free State. Maize fields stretch to the horizon, bigger than a whole village. A combine harvester roars along, cutting, shelling and filling a truck with golden grain. The trucks go to huge silos by the railway. From there, the maize goes to mills, factories and ships. This is commercial farming: big farms, machines, workers, and crops and animals grown to sell for a profit.
visual_style: Whiteboard field that keeps getting bigger as the camera pulls back, a combine harvester crossing it, then arrows from the field to silos, a mill, a shop and a ship.
mood: Big and powerful, like a machine at full speed.
pacing: Start in the field, zoom out to its size, follow the maize from field to shop.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look for a product from a South African farm in your kitchen.
